properties.description: The shipped gate checks the pins, and bites when they disagree (tools/reflow2_check.py, run against reflow2's own design 2026-08-06, 3 cases). GROUPING: five Cargo crates (dynograph-core/-storage/-graph/-resolution/-vector) match ONE declaration because observations are keyed by SOURCE, not by name — matching on name would have produced four false 'undeclared' findings and one backwards 'unobserved'. HONEST SILENCE: a project whose pins this gate cannot read reports 'N declared, and this gate could not read any build file to check them', rather than reconciling against an empty observation set, which would fire `unobserved` on every declaration and punish the correct behaviour.
properties.findings: POSITIVE: 1 declared, 1 observed across Cargo.toml and two crate manifests, reported as agreeing. NEGATIVE, which is the case that matters: the dynograph-foundation tag was temporarily bumped to a version that does not exist and the gate FAILED the build with `version_mismatch — declared v0.12.0 but the build resolves v0.99.0`, then passed again when restored.
properties.name: The shipped gate checks the dependency pins, and bites when they disagree
